subject: gk
question: Which traditional dance of Goa is performed during the Shigmo festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Morulem**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Shigmo or Shishirotsava is a spring festival celebrated in the Indian state of Goa
 
• It is one of the major festivals of the Hindu community.
 
• It is also celebrated by the Konkani diaspora and the Indian festival of Holi is part of it.
 
• Shigmo festivals also continue in various rural parts of Goa, spanning over a fortnight, with different days earmarked for celebrations in different areas.
 
• This festival is celebrated around March each year. 
 
• It is linked to the Hindu lunar calendar, hence its date according to the Gregorian calendar varies. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9293aefed86f125104677e529c0525e1af0c64ef0332b244c5a8e22c143c559.png] 

__
 
• There are two variants of the Shigmo festival: Dhakto Shigmo which is a small Shigmo and Vhadlo Shigmo which is a big Shigmo.
 
• Dhakto Shigmo is generally celebrated by farmers, the labor class, and the rural population
 
• While Vhadlo Shigmo is of greater consequence and is celebrated by everyone together.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Goa is a state in western India with coastlines stretching along the Arabian Sea. 
 
• Its long history as a Portuguese colony prior to 1961 is evident in its preserved 17th-century churches and the area’s tropical spice plantations. 
 
• Goa is also known for its beaches, ranging from popular stretches at Baga and Palolem to those in laid-back fishing villages such as Agonda.
 
• Land area: 3,702 km²
 
• Capital: Panaji 
 
• Chief minister: Pramod Sawant
 
• Population: 18.2 lakhs
